sample_unit: gold-standard patients (32 cases, 85 controls) for screener evaluation
unlisted_practices: Trainer module injecting meta-knowledge via a Learner agent to correct systemic reasoning errors in multi-agent LLM diagnostic panel
Walk-forward visit-by-visit simulation to assess how early the AI detects conditions before clinical diagnosis
Two-stage design with a high-specificity screener gating a multi-agent differential diagnosis engine to limit false positives

screen.reason: The study develops and performs an offline, walk-forward simulation of a new multi-agent LLM reasoning system (SPROUT) on retrospective longitudinal pediatric EHR data to evaluate diagnostic sensitivity and specificity, without evaluating a specific implementation practice or operational safeguard.
